purpose: Private mapping for neutral A/B review; do not share with blind judge.
selection_rationale: Eight representative locations (Lower Meadows, Stone and Root, Old Mill river lock, Ironwood, Stronghold approach, farm-to-Hall route, village road, Hall front), three paired conditions per location. Balanced day/golden/night and clear/rain; includes approach/detail/reverse plus one ordinary gameplay view where the farm-to-Hall site has no approach row. All selected IDs are exact intersection members with requested and actual weather equal and matching player/camera/stand metadata.
